variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: The union {name} has called a strike. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by the union {name}. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
